E001.Epic Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.
E001.Story Title: Authenticate Platform Owner's Social Media Access
E001.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to securely authenticate my LinkedIn and Facebook accounts so that the system can access my first-level contact information without compromising my login credentials.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system should provide an OAuth login for LinkedIn and Facebook.
Authentication must be secure and follow best practices for OAuth implementations.
The system should only request permissions necessary for accessing first-level contact information.

Tasks.Description: Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication for LinkedIn integration. This involves setting up an authentication flow that requests user approval and handles redirection to fetch access tokens securely for accessing user data.

Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication for Facebook integration, similar to LinkedIn. Ensure the authentication process securely handles credentials and tokens, while strictly adhering to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
Develop a function to handle the OAuth callback for both LinkedIn and Facebook. This function should securely receive the authorization code from the OAuth provider and exchange it for access tokens.

Create a permissions request module that only asks for necessary permissions from LinkedIn and Facebook to access first-level contact information, such as name, email, job title, and company, ensuring compliance with the minimum privilege principle.

Set up secure storage for OAuth tokens using encryption to store tokens locally. This storage solution must provide capabilities for token refresh and must invalidate tokens securely to handle token expiration.

Implement best practices for OAuth implementations such as secure storage of credentials, regular security audits of the authentication flows, and ensuring all communication with OAuth providers is done over HTTPS.
Develop unit tests to verify the OAuth authentication flow, token storage, and permissions handling for both LinkedIn and Facebook integrations are functioning as expected and are secure.

Create an integration test to simulate the authentication process with LinkedIn and Facebook, checking if the system correctly handles different scenarios such as user denial of permissions, token expiration, and renewal.

Document the setup process for OAuth with LinkedIn and Facebook, including detailed steps on registering the application with both services, configuring redirect URIs, and setting the scope of access permissions.

Develop a user interface component that triggers the OAuth flow for LinkedIn and Facebook. This component should provide clear information to the user about what data will be accessed and how it will be used.

E001.Epic Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.
E001.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to extract first-level contact details from LinkedIn and Facebook so that I can build a comprehensive database of my professional and personal contacts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Contact information should include name, email, job title, company, and social profile URLs.
The extraction process must handle pagination to ensure all contacts are retrieved.
Contacts must be deduplicated across both platforms.
Extracted data should be validated to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Tasks.Description: Create a function to authenticate the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook accounts using OAuth 2.0. This function should ensure secure connection and request only necessary permissions to access first-level contact information.

Develop a function to extract first-level contact information from LinkedIn and Facebook using the authenticated APIs. The function should retrieve fields such as name, email, job title, company, and social profile URLs.
Implement pagination handling in the data extraction function to manage API rate limits and ensure complete retrieval of all available first-level contacts from LinkedIn and Facebook.

Design and implement a deduplication algorithm that merges duplicate entries based on email and social profile URLs. This should cross-reference contacts from both LinkedIn and Facebook to maintain a unique list of contacts.

Incorporate validation checks within the data extraction function to verify the accuracy and completeness of each data field retrieved. This includes format validation for emails and URLs, and non-empty checks for essential fields like name and job title.

Create a local database schema to store the extracted contact information. The schema should support quick searches and data retrieval operations, and accommodate the fields extracted from social media.
Develop a function to save the validated and deduplicated contact information into the local database. Ensure data is stored in a structured format that facilitates easy access and manipulation.

E001.Epic Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.
E001.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to store the extracted contact information locally in JSON format so that I can ensure data privacy and security.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Extracted data should be stored in a structured JSON format.
Data storage should occur on the local machine or a designated secure local server.
The JSON file should include clear, human-readable labels for each data field.

Tasks.Description: Design a JSON schema that defines the structure for storing contact details such as name, email, job title, company, and social profile URLs. Ensure the schema supports clear, human-readable labels for each data field.

Develop a function in Python that takes extracted contact information as input and transforms it into a JSON object based on the designed schema. Include error handling to manage inconsistencies or missing data fields.
Implement a local storage mechanism using Python that checks for available storage space on the local machine or a designated secure server before saving the JSON file.
Create a function to serialize the JSON object and write it to a file on the local system. Ensure the file path and storage location are configurable and secured.
Develop unit tests to verify that the JSON output adheres to the schema, contains all required fields, and handles various edge cases such as large data volumes or special characters in the data.
Implement logging for the data storage process, capturing key actions such as successful storage, errors during serialization, or issues with file writing.
Construct a simple user interface or command-line interface that allows the platform owner to initiate the storage process manually and monitor its progress or troubleshoot errors.
Draft documentation that explains the JSON structure, the process of storing data locally, and guidelines for maintaining the privacy and security of the stored data.

E001.Epic Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.
E001.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to manually initiate a backup of the contact database so that I can prevent data loss.
Story Acceptance Criteria: There should be an option in the interface to manually trigger a backup.
Backup should create a timestamped copy of the JSON data file.
The system should verify the integrity of the backup file after completion.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface button within the existing GUI that allows the platform owner to manually initiate a data backup.
Implement backend functionality to create a timestamped copy of the JSON data file when the backup button is triggered.
Develop a method to verify the integrity of the backup file post-creation to ensure the file is not corrupted and is complete.
Integrate the backup functionality into the main application flow, ensuring it interacts seamlessly with other features.
Add logging functionality to record each backup attempt, noting the time, success, or failure of the backup.
Test the manual backup process under different scenarios, including normal conditions and simulated faults, to ensure reliability.
Update the system documentation to include instructions on how to use the new manual backup feature.
Conduct a security assessment to ensure that the backup process maintains data confidentiality and integrity.

E001.Epic Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.
E001.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to view and edit the details of my stored contacts so that I can ensure the information is current and accurate.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system should provide a GUI to display contact details.
Editing functionality should allow modifying all stored fields of contact information.
Changes should be saved immediately to the local JSON file.

Tasks.Description: Design the GUI layout for displaying contact details which includes the contact's name, email, job title, company, and social profile URLs. Ensure the design is clear and aligns with the platform's style guide.
Implement the frontend code for the GUI using a suitable framework (e.g., React, Vue.js) to render contact details dynamically based on the stored JSON data.
Develop backend API to fetch contact details from the local JSON file. Ensure the API can handle requests to retrieve specific contact information and send it to the frontend.

Create an editing interface within the GUI that allows the user to modify contact details. Include text fields for editable information and ensure each field validates input to maintain data integrity.

Implement functionality to write changes made in the GUI back to the local JSON file immediately after modification. Use file handling mechanisms in the backend to ensure atomic write operations to prevent data corruption.
Integrate frontend and backend components so that changes made through the GUI are reflected in real-time, and ensure the system performs efficiently even with large JSON files.

Conduct unit testing on each component (frontend display, API, editing interface, JSON file writing) to ensure they meet the functional requirements and handle edge cases, such as invalid inputs or file access issues.

Arrange a user testing session with the Platform Owner to gather feedback on the usability of the GUI and the effectiveness of the editing functionality. Adjust the design and functionality based on feedback to ensure it meets user expectations and needs.

Prepare documentation detailing the usage of the GUI for viewing and editing contact details, including steps for performing edits and saving changes. Include troubleshooting steps for common issues users might encounter.
Implement secure access controls to ensure that only authenticated users can access and modify contact information. Integrate these controls with the platform's existing security infrastructure.

OpenAI transformers analyze text to identify and catalog interests within the contact's profile.
Updated profiles are saved with new personal interest data in the local database.
Platform owner can review enriched data on a user interface.

Tasks.Description: Implement a data extraction module to fetch data points related to personal interests from social media platforms. Inputs: User credentials and platform API keys. Outputs: Raw data of user posts and activities.
Integrate OAuth authentication to ensure secure access to the user's social media accounts. Inputs: OAuth credentials. Outputs: Authenticated session tokens.

Develop a text analysis function using OpenAI transformers to process the extracted social media data. Inputs: Raw text data from social media. Outputs: Structured data with identified personal interests.
Create a database schema to store enriched profiles with new personal interest data. Inputs: Structured data with personal interests. Outputs: Confirmation of data storage.
Implement a function to update existing contact profiles in the local database with the new enriched data. Inputs: New personal interest data. Outputs: Updated contact profiles in the database.

Develop a user interface component for the platform owner to review enriched contact data. Inputs: Request to view specific contact profiles. Outputs: Display of enriched contact profiles with identified personal interests.

E002.Epic Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.

E002.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to enrich contact profiles with family information such as marital status and children, so that I can create more personalized marketing messages that resonate with the contact's family dynamics.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System identifies mentions of family-related information from social media posts and profile details.
OpenAI transformers interpret and classify family information accurately.
Contact profiles are updated with family information in the local database.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a data extraction module to identify mentions of family-related information in social media posts and profile details. Inputs include raw social media data; outputs are extracted text snippets containing potential family information.

Integrate OpenAI transformers to analyze the extracted family-related snippets and classify the information into structured categories such as marital status and children. Inputs are text snippets; outputs are classified family data in JSON format.

Develop a function to update existing contact profiles in the local database with the newly classified family information. Inputs are classified family data and existing contact profiles; outputs are updated contact profiles stored in the database.

Create a user interface component in the system's GUI that allows the platform owner to view the enriched family information within contact profiles. Inputs are user commands through GUI interactions; outputs are views displaying family information within the GUI.

E002.Epic Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.

Data is processed and verified using AI to ensure it reflects current interests.
Activity data is accurately incorporated into the existing contact profiles.
Profiles with updated activity information are accessible to the platform owner.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a module to authenticate user access to social media APIs using OAuth. This module should manage the secure storage of access tokens and handle token refresh mechanisms.

Implement a function to automatically extract activities and events data from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles. The function should handle API rate limits and pagination to ensure complete data retrieval.

Create an AI processing module using OpenAI transformers that analyzes the extracted activity data to identify and highlight current interests relevant to marketing efforts. This module should include preprocessing of text data for better AI comprehension.

Develop a data integration function that merges the AI-processed activity data with existing contact profiles in the database. Ensure that this function checks for duplicates and maintains data consistency.

Set up a user interface component in the existing system that enables the platform owner to view and interact with the enriched profiles. This interface should be user-friendly and provide clear access to updated activity information.
Write unit tests for each function to ensure they handle expected and edge cases correctly, including tests for API connectivity, data processing accuracy, and user interface responsiveness.

E002.Epic Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.
E002.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to analyze and record the travel history of my contacts by interpreting posts and check-ins, so that I can offer travel-related products or services more effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Extraction of relevant travel-related posts and check-ins.
Use of OpenAI transformers to analyze and interpret travel data.
Travel history is added to the contact's profile in the local database.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a data extraction module that connects to social media APIs to fetch travel-related posts and check-ins. Inputs include API credentials and user identifiers, with outputs being raw travel-related data.

Develop a parsing algorithm to filter and extract relevant travel information from raw social media data. The algorithm should identify keywords and patterns related to travel activities. Input is raw social media data, and output is structured travel data.

Integrate OpenAI transformer models to analyze and interpret the extracted travel data. This task requires setting up the AI model environment, configuring the model for text analysis, and processing the structured travel data through the model.

Implement functionality in the local database for adding travel history to contact profiles. This includes database operations for inserting and updating travel data linked to specific contacts.

Develop a user interface component that allows the platform owner to view and interact with the travel history data. This task involves creating views, handling user interactions, and presenting travel data in a user-friendly manner.

Ensure data privacy and security by implementing access controls and encryption for travel data stored locally. This includes setting up encryption for travel data at rest and configuring access permissions.

Conduct a series of tests to validate the accuracy and reliability of the travel data extraction and processing workflow. This includes unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing with feedback incorporation.

Prepare documentation detailing the workflow for extracting, processing, and utilizing travel-related data. The documentation should include setup guides, usage instructions, and troubleshooting tips for platform owners.

E002.Epic Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.
E002.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match the enriched profiles against the characteristics of the products or services I wish to promote, so that I can generate a curated list of contacts most likely to be interested.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System uses enhanced profiles to match with input product/service characteristics.
Generation of a detailed list of matching contacts based on profile similarities and product/service features.
Curated lists are accessible and can be exported by the platform owner for outreach.
Ensure high accuracy in matching to maximize outreach potential.

Tasks.Description: Design a function to read and parse the JSON file containing the enhanced contact profiles. This function should accept the path to the JSON file as an input and return a list of profile objects.

Implement a function to receive product or service characteristics. This function should accept multiple parameters like product name, description, target demographic, etc., and should return a structured object representing these details.

Develop an algorithm to match contact profiles with the input product/service characteristics. The algorithm should compare data fields from both the product/service object and the contact profiles to find matches based on predefined rules or similarity measures.

Create a function to generate a list of matching contacts. This function should use the results from the matching algorithm to compile a detailed list that includes contact details and a relevance score or matching percentage.
Implement functionality to sort the list of matching contacts based on the relevance score or matching percentage to prioritize the most relevant contacts at the top of the list.

Design and implement a secure, local storage system to save the generated list of contacts. This function should accept the list of contacts and a file path, saving the data in JSON or CSV format locally.
Develop a function to export the curated contact list to an Excel file. This should include formatting the Excel document to make it readable and include all necessary contact details.

Create a validation component to ensure high accuracy in the matching process. This component should perform checks on the matching logic to confirm it adheres to the specified criteria and catches potential errors or mismatches.
Integrate all components into a main application flow, which orchestrates the entire process from input reception, processing, matching, list generation, to exporting the file.
Test the entire system using a series of unit tests and integration tests to ensure that each component works as expected individually and when integrated.

E003.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details of a specific product or service, so that these can be used to find matching profiles in the contact database.

The system confirms receipt of the input data.

Implement form validation to verify that the input text does not exceed the character limit and adheres to the predefined format requirements.
Develop backend functionality to receive and store the input data from the GUI form securely on the local system.
Ensure that the system provides immediate visual confirmation on the GUI that the product or service details have been successfully received and stored.
Write unit tests to check the functionality of the input field, including boundary conditions for the character limit and response handling.
Create system logs for the input operation to record the time of entry, the type of data entered, and any other relevant metadata for auditing and troubleshooting purposes.

E003.Epic Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement an input module for product or service details, allowing the platform owner to provide necessary attributes such as name, type, and target demographics.

Integrate OpenAI transformers within the system to analyze the input product or service details and generate a target audience profile based on demographics, interests, and other relevant attributes.
Create a data model to structure the output of the AI-generated profiles, ensuring all relevant attributes like age group, interests, and purchasing power are included and correctly formatted.

Implement performance optimization techniques ensuring that the profile generation process completes within a reasonable time frame, considering system resources and expected data volumes.
Build unit tests to validate the functionality of the OpenAI integration, data validation, and profile generation, ensuring that all components interact correctly and efficiently.
Conduct integration testing to verify the interaction between the input module, AI processing, and data storage, ensuring data integrity and performance are maintained.
Prepare documentation detailing the usage of the AI-generated profile feature, including guidelines on input formats, expected outcomes, and troubleshooting common issues.

E003.Epic Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.
E003.Story Title: User Story: Match Profiles with Contact Database
E003.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match the generated product/service profile with profiles in the enhanced contact database, so that I can identify potential targets efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The matching process uses attributes such as interests, demographics, and activities.
The system displays the percentage match for potential contacts.
Only contacts matching above a specified threshold are included in the results.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a data model for the product/service profile that includes attributes such as interests, demographics, and activities. This model will be used to match against profiles in the contact database.

Develop a function to extract the matching attributes from the enhanced contact database. This function should handle the extraction of interests, demographics, and activities from each contact's profile.
Create an algorithm that compares each contact's extracted attributes with the input product/service profile. The algorithm should calculate a match percentage based on the similarity of attributes.
Implement a filtering mechanism in the matching algorithm that only includes contacts in the results if they match above a specified threshold percentage. This threshold should be configurable.
Develop a function to display the matching results, including the contact's name, profile details, and the calculated matching percentage.

Integrate the matching function with the existing system to ensure it works with the current data flow and user interface. This includes fetching data from the local database and returning matching results.
Test the matching functionality extensively with various test cases to ensure accuracy in the matching process and that it meets the specified threshold criteria.
Document the usage of the matching function including how to configure the match threshold and how to interpret the matching percentage results.
Conduct a security review to ensure that the matching process and data handling adhere to privacy standards and secure coding practices.

E003.Epic Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.
E003.Story Title: User Story: Generate Curated Contact Lists
E003.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to generate a list of contacts that match the product/service profile, so that I can target them with tailored marketing efforts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The list includes contact name, social media profiles, and matching percentage.
Contacts are sorted by relevance based on the matching percentage.
The system allows exporting the list to an Excel file.

Tasks.Description: Design a function in Python named `generate_matching_contact_list` which inputs product/service characteristics and outputs a list of contacts. This function will internally call other functions to fetch contacts, match profiles, and sort them accordingly.
Create a module for fetching contact profiles from the local database. This module should include a function `fetch_contact_profiles` that returns all contact profiles stored in the JSON format.

Develop a function called `match_profiles` in Python that accepts two arguments: a list of contact profiles and the product/service characteristics. This function should apply matching logic based on criteria provided in the product/service input and return a list of contacts that match the criteria, including a matching percentage.
Implement a sorting function named `sort_contacts_by_relevance` that sorts the list of matched contacts by the matching percentage in descending order. The function should return the sorted list.

Create a Python function `export_contacts_to_excel` which takes a list of sorted and matched contacts as input and exports them to an Excel file. The function should ensure that the format and data integrity are maintained.

Integrate the above functions in a main control function `process_contact_matching` which orchestrates the fetching, matching, sorting, and exporting of the contact data. This function serves as the main entry point for the contact matching feature.
Ensure all functions handle possible exceptions and errors by implementing try-except blocks where appropriate. This includes handling errors in data fetching, processing, sorting, and exporting.

Test the functions independently before integration to ensure they meet their individual acceptance criteria as specified. Create unit tests for `fetch_contact_profiles`, `match_profiles`, `sort_contacts_by_relevance`, and `export_contacts_to_excel`.

After integration, conduct end-to-end testing of the `process_contact_matching` function to verify that the workflow from fetching profiles to exporting the Excel file works as expected and aligns with the user story and acceptance criteria.
Document the usage of the system functions including inputs, outputs, expected results, and exception handling to aid in maintenance and future enhancements.

E003.Epic Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.

E004.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details about the products or services I am promoting so that the system can identify relevant contacts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System allows easy input of product/service details through a simple GUI.
Input data includes product descriptions, target demographics, and any special requirements.
GUI confirms successful data entry with an acknowledgment message.

Tasks.Description: Design a GUI form to input product or service details. The form should include fields for product name, description, target demographics, and any special requirements. Ensure the design is user-friendly and intuitive.

Implement form validation to check the correctness and completeness of the input data. This should include checks for empty fields, data type validation (e.g., text, numbers), and any other specific validation rules necessary for the input fields.
Develop the backend functionality to process and store the input product/service details locally. Ensure that the data storage is secure and complies with data privacy standards.

Create a confirmation mechanism on the GUI that triggers upon successful data entry. This mechanism might include a popup message or a visual indicator that confirms the data has been successfully captured and saved.
Integrate the input form with the existing local database to ensure that the input data can be used immediately for further processing, such as matching with contact profiles.
Conduct tests to validate the entire input process from the GUI to the database. Include unit tests for individual components and integration tests for the overall workflow.
Prepare documentation for the GUI input functionality, detailing how to use the form, what each field represents, and troubleshooting common issues during data entry.

E004.Epic Description: Generate curated lists of contacts likely interested in the specific product or service offerings inputted by the platform owner, including contact details and relevant social media profiles.
E004.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to match my product and service offerings with the enhanced profiles so that I can receive a curated list of potentially interested contacts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System processes input product/service details and matches them with contact profiles using AI.
Generate lists that include contact details and relevance scores based on potential interest in the offering.
Allow the platform owner to review and modify the generated lists before finalizing.

Tasks.Description: Design the AI matching algorithm that processes input product/service details and matches them with enhanced contact profiles. The algorithm should prioritize attributes such as interests, activities, demographics, and professional background to determine potential interest in the product/service.

Develop a function to extract product/service attributes from user input and convert these details into a format suitable for processing by the AI matching algorithm. Ensure the function validates the input data for completeness and correctness.

Implement a system to generate lists of contacts, including essential contact details like name, social media profiles, and a relevance score indicating the match strength with the product/service offering. Ensure the list generation process is optimized for performance and handles large datasets efficiently.

Create a function to allow the platform owner to review and modify the generated lists of contacts. This function should provide options to sort, add, or remove contacts and recompute scores as necessary.
Integrate the AI system with the local database to pull enhanced contact profiles for matching. Ensure secure and efficient data retrieval to maintain performance and data integrity.

Develop a user interface component that allows the platform owner to input product or service details into the system. This component should have form fields for all necessary attributes and validate inputs to ensure data integrity.
Implement user interface elements to display the generated contact lists in a readable and organized format, including functionality to sort by relevance score and other criteria.
Create user interface options for exporting the curated contact lists, allowing the platform owner to save the list in a structured format like Excel or CSV for external use.
Establish a secure, local storage system for saving and retrieving the generated contact lists, ensuring that all data manipulation occurs locally without exposure to external networks.
Implement logging and audit mechanisms to track the performance and usage of the contact matching system, ensuring that all actions are logged for review and potential debugging.
Conduct integration testing of the entire contact matching system to evaluate the seamless interaction between input handling, AI processing, list generation, and user interface functionalities.

E004.Epic Description: Generate curated lists of contacts likely interested in the specific product or service offerings inputted by the platform owner, including contact details and relevant social media profiles.
E004.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to export the curated lists of contacts to Excel so that I can utilize them for outreach efforts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Export function includes all relevant contact details and any additional notes or tags from the analysis.
Excel files are formatted for easy reading and further manipulation if required.
Ensure the export process is secure and maintains the confidentiality of the contact data.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a function `export_to_excel(data, file_path)` that takes in a list of contact details (data) and a file path (file_path) where the Excel file will be saved. This function should handle the conversion of data into an Excel format ensuring that all relevant contact details and any additional notes or tags from the analysis are included.

Develop a module for formatting the Excel output. This should include setting column widths, headers, and possibly applying filters for easier manipulation of data within Excel. Ensure that the format is easy to read and manipulate as required by stakeholders.

Implement security measures within the export functionality to maintain the confidentiality of the contact data. This includes ensuring that the data is written directly to the specified location without temporary storage in insecure locations and using secure libraries/functions for file handling.

Create a user interface button or command within the GUI that triggers the `export_to_excel` function. This should be clearly labeled and accessible, allowing the platform owner to specify the file path where the Excel file will be saved.
Integrate the export functionality into the main system flow, ensuring that it pulls the correct and most recent curated contact lists from the system’s storage when the export command is initiated.
Perform unit testing on the `export_to_excel` function to ensure data is correctly and securely exported to Excel. This includes testing with different data sets to ensure robustness and security.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the export function works seamlessly within the GUI and that the data integrity and security are maintained during the export process.

E004.Epic Description: Generate curated lists of contacts likely interested in the specific product or service offerings inputted by the platform owner, including contact details and relevant social media profiles.
E004.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want all data to be stored locally and have robust backup processes so that I can ensure data security and availability.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Data stored in non-encrypted JSON files locally on the platform owner's device.
System provides a manual backup option and instructions for the platform owner to secure data.
Alerts the platform owner of successful or failed backup attempts.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a local storage solution that stores data in non-encrypted JSON files on the platform owner's device. Ensure the directory structure is secure and accessible only through the application.
Develop a user interface component within the application that allows the platform owner to manually initiate data backups. Include clear instructions within the interface on how to perform backups.
Implement a backup functionality that creates a timestamped copy of the JSON data files to a secure, designated backup location specified by the platform owner.
Create a system notification feature that alerts the platform owner of the status of backup attempts, including successful completions and detailed error messages on failures.
Ensure that the local storage system logs all backup attempts, including timestamps and status, to maintain a record of data integrity and backup history.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want all data to be stored in local JSON files so that I can ensure the privacy and security of sensitive information.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Data is stored in JSON format on the local machine.
No data is stored or transferred to cloud services.
All stored data must be accessible only through the application.

Tasks.Description: Design a local storage system to save data in JSON format. Define the JSON schema to ensure it captures all necessary fields according to user requirements.
Implement file handling methods in Python to create, read, and write JSON files. These methods must ensure data integrity and error handling to prevent data corruption.
Develop a function to encrypt the JSON data before saving to disk to enhance security. Include key management practices for encryption and decryption processes.

Create access control mechanisms to ensure that JSON files are only accessible through the application. This involves setting file permissions and possibly integrating user authentication within the application.
Incorporate functionality within the application to verify the integrity of the JSON files on every read operation. Implement checksum or hash verification methods.

Configure the application environment to prevent any data storage or transfer to cloud services. This may involve setting up environment variables or configuration files that explicitly disable remote storage options.

Develop user interface components that allow users to interact with the data only through defined application workflows. This includes creating forms, views, or other UI elements that facilitate data interaction without exposing the underlying storage directly.

Implement logging mechanisms to record all access and operations performed on the JSON files. This will help in auditing and monitoring data access patterns and identifying potential unauthorized access attempts.

Conduct thorough testing of the data storage functionalities to ensure they meet security standards and functional requirements. This includes unit tests, integration tests, and security vulnerability assessments.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to implement a manual backup system so that I can securely back up data to prevent loss.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system provides an option to manually initiate data backups.
Backups must be stored in a secure location specified by the Platform Owner.
The system must confirm successful completion of backups.

Tasks.Description: Design a backup initiation mechanism within the application that allows the Platform Owner to manually trigger data backups. This should include a user interface component like a button or command within the application's main menu.

Implement backend functionality to handle the backup process once triggered. This should involve the copying of JSON data files to a backup directory specified by the user, ensuring that the data integrity is maintained during the copy process.

Create a configuration setting in the application where the Platform Owner can specify the secure location for storing backups. This setting should be stored persistently and used as the default backup location unless changed by the user.

Develop a feedback mechanism that confirms the successful completion of the backup to the user. This should include both a success message displayed in the GUI and a system log entry noting the date and time of the backup.

Implement security measures to ensure that the backup directory and the backup process are secure. This includes setting appropriate permissions on the backup directory and protecting the backup process from unauthorized access or interference.

Test the backup functionality to ensure that it works correctly across different operating systems and configurations. This includes verifying that the data is accurately copied, the user is correctly notified, and the backups are stored securely as specified.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to perform routine integrity checks on the stored data so that I can trust the data's accuracy and completeness.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Integrity checks are performed automatically at set intervals.
Any issues detected during checks are logged and reported to the Platform Owner.
The system can recover corrupted data from the latest backup if integrity checks fail.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a function for routine data integrity checks. This function should automatically run at set intervals (e.g., daily), verifying the integrity of the JSON data files stored locally. Inputs to this function will include the file paths to the JSON files, and the output will be a status report of the check.

Develop a logging system to record the results of each data integrity check. The system should log both the status of the checks and any issues found. Inputs will include the results from the integrity check function, and outputs will be entries in a log file accessible to the Platform Owner.

Create a data recovery function that can restore corrupted data from the most recent backup. This function should be triggered if the integrity check fails, using the latest backup file as input. The output will be the restoration of the JSON data file to its last known good state.

Implement a user notification system within the platform to alert the Platform Owner about the results of integrity checks, especially if any issues are detected or if a data recovery process is initiated. The input will be the logs from the integrity check, and the output will be an alert or notification sent to the Platform Owner.

Set up a task scheduler in the system to automate the execution of the data integrity checks according to the specified intervals. This scheduler should handle the timing of checks without user intervention. The input will be the configuration settings for the intervals, and the output will be the triggered execution of the integrity check function.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the system to require authentication for accessing the local data storage so that unauthorized access is prevented.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access to the JSON files is gated by authentication requiring a username and password.
The system logs all access attempts, successful or failed.
Multiple failed access attempts result in a temporary lockout to prevent brute-force attacks.

Tasks.Description: Develop a secure authentication system for accessing local JSON files. This system should require both a username and password for entry.
Implement logging functionality to record all access attempts to the JSON files, capturing both successful and failed attempts.

Create a security mechanism that temporarily locks out a user after multiple failed access attempts to prevent brute-force attacks. The system should define the maximum allowed failed attempts before a lockout is triggered.
Integrate the authentication system with the existing local data management infrastructure to ensure that all access to JSON files is securely controlled.
Test the authentication module to verify that only authorized users can access the JSON files and that all unauthorized attempts are correctly logged and handled.
Document the setup process for the authentication system, including configuration settings for username and password requirements, lockout mechanisms, and logging details.
Implement front-end components in the GUI to allow the platform owner to easily manage authentication credentials and review access logs.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the ability to export data from JSON files to Excel so that I can easily review and manipulate the data outside the system.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Exported data must reflect the current state of the JSON files.
The system provides options for selecting specific data fields for export.
Exported Excel files are stored locally and are not emailed or uploaded to cloud services.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a function 'export_json_to_excel' in Python which reads data from a specified JSON file and converts it into an Excel format. The function should take a JSON file path as input and output the path of the Excel file created.

Implement data validation within the 'export_json_to_excel' function to ensure that data being read from the JSON file matches the expected format and schema before conversion. If data does not match, the function should raise a descriptive error.

Create a user interface component (button or a command-line option) that allows the platform owner to initiate the export from JSON to Excel. This component should call the 'export_json_to_excel' function.

Add functionality within the system to allow the platform owner to select specific fields from the JSON file that they wish to export. This could be implemented via a GUI checkbox list of available JSON fields.

Ensure the exported Excel file is stored locally by implementing a file-saving dialog that allows the platform owner to specify the storage location on their local machine or network. The system should verify write permissions to the chosen location before proceeding.

Implement a logging mechanism to track each export action, including timestamp, the user who initiated the export, the JSON source file, and the Excel destination file. This log should be stored securely on the local system.

Perform rigorous testing to ensure the export function handles large JSON files efficiently without significant performance degradation or crashes. This includes stress testing with multiple, consecutive exports.
Develop comprehensive documentation for the 'export_json_to_excel' functionality, including how to use it, its limitations, and troubleshooting steps if the export does not work as expected.

E005.Epic Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.
E005.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want a secure method to delete outdated or unnecessary data from the local storage without affecting integrity so that I can manage storage space and maintain data relevancy.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system allows for selective deletion of data entries.
Deletion actions require confirmation from the Platform Owner to proceed.
The system logs all deletion activities for audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a function to list all current data entries from the local JSON storage. This function will allow the Platform Owner to view and select which data entries to delete, ensuring that deletion is selective and controlled.

Develop a user interface component that allows the Platform Owner to select and confirm the deletion of specific data entries. This component should require manual confirmation from the Platform Owner to proceed with the deletion, safeguarding against accidental data loss.

Create a backend process that securely deletes selected data entries from the local JSON storage. This process must ensure that only the selected entries are removed, and the integrity of the remaining data is maintained.

Implement a logging mechanism that records all deletion activities. Each log entry should capture details such as the timestamp of the deletion, the data entries deleted, and the identity of the Platform Owner who confirmed the deletion.
Integrate the deletion functionality with the existing local data management system to ensure seamless operation and compatibility with other data handling features.
Conduct thorough testing to verify that the deletion process works as intended, data integrity is maintained after deletions, and all user actions are correctly logged.
Prepare documentation for the Platform Owner on how to use the new deletion feature, including step-by-step instructions and information on the logging of deletion activities.

E006.Epic Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
E006.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to input details of products or services into the GUI so that I can specify the offerings for which I need targeted contact lists.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A form is provided in the GUI to input product or service details.
The form must include fields for all necessary attributes like name, description, and any specific filters or criteria.
Input data is validated for correctness and completeness before being accepted.

Tasks.Description: Design a user form interface in the GUI for inputting product or service details. The form should include fields for the product or service name, description, and any specific filters or criteria relevant to the platform owner's needs.

Implement form validation logic in the GUI to ensure that all input data is correct and complete before submission. This includes checks for empty fields, data type validation (e.g., strings for names, numeric values where applicable), and format validation for specific criteria (e.g., date formats).

Develop backend functionality to handle the reception, processing, and storage of data input through the product/service details form. Ensure that data is stored securely and is accessible only through defined interfaces and services.

Integrate frontend and backend systems to ensure seamless data flow from the GUI input form to the storage system, maintaining data integrity and security. Include error handling to manage and report any issues during the data input process.

Create unit tests to validate the functionality of the input form, focusing on both the frontend and backend aspects. Tests should cover various scenarios including valid and invalid data submissions, and edge cases for data handling.

Conduct integration testing to ensure that the entire process from data input in the GUI to data storage works seamlessly and securely, and that the user is alerted of the success or failure of data input.
Document the functionality and usage of the product/service input form for end-users, providing guidelines on how to effectively use the form to input their product or service details.

E006.Epic Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
E006.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want to be able to view the generated contact lists on the GUI so that I can review and verify the contacts selected based on my input details.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The GUI displays the list of contacts in a readable and organized format.
The list includes essential contact details such as name, email, and social profile links.
The GUI provides an option to refresh or regenerate the list based on the same or modified input criteria.

Tasks.Description: Design the GUI layout for displaying contact lists, ensuring it is readable and organized. Include sections for name, email, and social profile links.
Implement functionality to fetch contact data from the local database and populate the GUI list view dynamically.
Develop a filtering and sorting mechanism in the GUI that allows the platform owner to view the contact list based on specified criteria such as name, email, or recently added.
Create buttons or interactive elements in the GUI to allow the platform owner to refresh the contact list to reflect the latest data or apply new filters.
Incorporate error handling in the GUI to manage and display errors during data fetching or processing to ensure the system remains user-friendly and informative.
Ensure secure handling of data within the GUI operations, adhering to local data access protocols to prevent unauthorized data exposure.
Implement unit tests for the GUI functions that handle the display and updating of the contact lists to ensure reliability and correctness.
Review and optimize the performance of the GUI when handling large sets of contact data to avoid lags or crashes, ensuring a smooth user experience.
Validate the GUI implementation against the acceptance criteria to ensure all requirements are met, particularly focusing on data presentation and refresh/regeneration capabilities.

E006.Epic Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
E006.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want an option to export the generated contact lists to an Excel file so that I can use them for outreach or other business processes outside the platform.
Story Acceptance Criteria: A clear and accessible option to export the contact list to Excel is available in the GUI.
The exported file must preserve the organization and formatting of the data displayed in the GUI.
The export process should handle large data sets efficiently, ensuring a quick response time and minimal disruption.

Tasks.Description: Design an export button on the GUI that is clearly labeled and prominently positioned to allow users to export contact lists to Excel.

Implement the functionality to convert the displayed contact list data into an Excel format, ensuring that all data fields like name, email, and social profile links are correctly mapped and included in the output file.
Ensure that the formatting of data in the Excel export matches the organization of the data as shown in the GUI, including headings, columns, and any grouping or sorting.
Develop backend logic to handle large data sets during the Excel export process, optimizing for performance to ensure that the system responds quickly even when handling extensive data.
Conduct testing to verify that the export function works seamlessly across different operating systems and Excel versions, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Implement error handling for the export process to manage any issues such as permission errors, disk space limitations, or interrupted export processes, providing clear error messages to the user.
Set up a feedback mechanism in the GUI that confirms to the user once an export is successfully completed or notifies them of any issues during the export process.

E006.Epic Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
E006.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the software to handle data securely in the local system without transmitting it over the internet so that I can maintain control over the privacy of my data.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All data inputs and outputs are handled locally within the GUI, with no data sent to or stored in the cloud.
The system has provisions for local data backup and recovery in case of data loss.
The design adheres to best practices for secure data handling and storage.

Tasks.Description: Design a GUI architecture that operates entirely offline, ensuring that all data inputs and outputs are stored and processed locally without any cloud interaction. The architecture should support local data handling processes such as inputting, updating, and deleting data.

Implement local storage mechanisms using suitable local database or file system technologies such as SQLite or JSON files to store data securely on the local machine. Ensure that the storage mechanism is robust and supports the data structure required by the GUI.

Develop a local data backup system integrated within the GUI. This system should allow the platform owner to manually initiate backups and securely store backup data in a predefined local path. Include functionality to schedule automatic backups if required.

Implement security measures for data access and manipulation through the GUI. This includes setting up authentication for accessing the GUI, encrypting sensitive data stored locally, and ensuring that data integrity is maintained during any data handling operations.

Create a user interface within the GUI that allows the platform owner to perform data input operations without needing an internet connection. This interface should include form fields and necessary validations to ensure data correctness before it is stored locally.

Develop functionality to verify the integrity of stored data periodically and after any data backup operation. Implement mechanisms to recover data from the latest backup in case any integrity issues are detected.

Incorporate best practices for secure data handling and storage into the GUI design. This includes using secure coding practices, implementing proper error handling and logging mechanisms, and designing a user-friendly interface that clearly communicates the state of data security to the platform owner.

E006.Epic Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
E006.Story Description: As a Platform Owner, I want the GUI to be simple and intuitive so that I can easily navigate and use the software without requiring extensive training or technical support.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The user interface is clean, with a clear layout and minimalistic design.
All functionalities (input, view, export) are easily accessible from the main interface.
The system provides helpful hints or tooltips as necessary to guide the user through various tasks.

Tasks.Description: Design a wireframe for the GUI highlighting a clean and minimalistic layout that incorporates the functionalities of inputting product/service details, viewing generated contact lists, and exporting these lists. Ensure the main functionalities are prominently accessible from the main interface.

Develop a prototype of the GUI based on the wireframe. Include intuitive navigation elements that guide the user through inputting, viewing, and exporting processes without clutter. Use straightforward icons and buttons that are easily recognizable.
Implement the GUI using a suitable frontend framework that supports responsive design to ensure accessibility across different devices and screen sizes.

Integrate interactive elements such as tooltips or pop-up help boxes that provide users with information on what each GUI element does. Ensure these hints are concise and helpful, appearing on hover or click.

Test the GUI with potential users to gather feedback on the usability and intuitiveness of the layout, navigation, and interactive elements. Adjust the design and functionalities based on the feedback to enhance user experience.
Ensure all user inputs are validated both on the front-end and back-end to prevent errors and ensure the data integrity. Display clear error messages that guide users to correct mistakes.

Develop functionality to export data to Excel, ensuring the exported file maintains the structure and format as seen in the GUI. Implement progress indicators and success/error messages to inform users of the export status.

Conduct accessibility testing to ensure the GUI complies with accessibility standards such as WCAG. Make necessary adjustments to support users with disabilities, including keyboard navigability and screen reader support.

Implement rigorous security measures to handle data securely within the local system, ensuring that no data is sent over the internet. Use encryption for stored data and secure coding practices to protect data integrity and privacy.
Prepare comprehensive documentation on how to navigate and use the GUI. Include screenshots and step-by-step instructions on accessing and using each functionality.
